title: AOE3 — Agent Operating Engine: deterministic execution governance for autonomous AI agents

creators.name: Khiri, Musab Badewi Mustafa
creators.affiliation: Mk AOE Three For Technology Solutions, Dubai, UAE

description: AOE3 documents an integrity and reproducibility mechanism for agentic AI: every action carries a recorded, independently verifiable authorization — authority before execution, independent evidence after execution. UNKNOWN ≠ PASS.
